# hallpass_git_access_profile (Resource)

An access profile of a git remote: which repositories agents may clone, fetch and push, with which push rules, and the login key the gateway uses (`hallpass_login_key`; on GitHub add its `public_key` as a deploy key). Patterns match repository paths without `.git`, case-insensitively: `*` within one segment, `**` across segments, `?` one character, `{a,b}` alternatives. Destroying it deletes the profile and revokes its login keys. Import with the role ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_git_access_profile" "acme_read" {
  server_id    = hallpass_git_remote.github.id
  alias        = "acme-read"
  repositories = ["acme/**"]
}

resource "hallpass_git_access_profile" "acme_push" {
  server_id          = hallpass_git_remote.github.id
  alias              = "acme-push"
  repositories       = ["acme/{api,web}"]
  allow_push         = true
  branches           = ["agent/**"]
  protected_branches = ["main", "release/*"]
  approvals_required = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Profile name, unique on the remote.
- `repositories` (Set of String) Repository patterns, e.g. `acme/{api,web}` or `acme/**`.
- `server_id` (String) Git remote ID (`srv_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `allow_branch_delete` (Boolean) Allow deleting branches that `branches` matches.
- `allow_force_push` (Boolean) Allow rewriting branch history. Off: every branch update must be a fast-forward HallPass can prove from the pushed commits.
- `allow_push` (Boolean) Allow pushing (limited by the branch and tag rules); otherwise clone and fetch only.
- `approvals_required` (Number) Distinct approvers each request needs (1-5). Above 1, policy never approves automatically and any one denial ends the request.
- `branches` (Set of String) Branches agents may create and update, relative to `refs/heads/` (e.g. `agent/**`). Needs `allow_push`.
- `default_duration` (String) Access duration when the agent does not ask for one. A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.
- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the profile is enabled. Disabling ends active access within seconds and cancels pending requests; enabling lets policy decide again.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the profile, used by policy selectors.
- `max_duration` (String) Longest access an agent may request (policy may lower it). A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.
- `protected_branches` (Set of String) Branches never changed, even when `branches` matches (e.g. `main`).
- `remote_user` (String) Account on the git host (`git` for GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket).
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags agents may create (existing tags are never moved or deleted). Empty: no tags.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Profile ID (`rol_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role ID
terraform import hallpass_git_access_profile.acme_push rol_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
